commits.subject: fix(predict): exclude pinch-hit subs from projected lineup fallback
commits.body:
Prior game boxscores include subs (battingOrder 101, 201, etc.) alongside
starters (100, 200, etc.). The fallback was returning all of them, inflating
the batter count from 9 to 11+ and shifting prediction rankings.

Now deduplicates by lineup position, keeping only the original starter
(lowest battingOrder per slot).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
